label: sdc02_0080_teacher_01
text: Did you manage to catch an Alolan Form\nPokémon for me?

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_02
text: Keep searching and I’m sure you’ll find one.\nJust imagine you’re out on a nice stroll in Alola!

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_03
text: Ahhh, regrettably, that is not an Alolan Form\nPokémon...

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_04
text: That’s one, all right! You have, without a doubt,\ngot yourself an Alolan [VAR 0x0101(0001)]!

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_05
text: It’s able to glide about by concentrating its\npsychic power in its tail. This Pokémon has\r\nsometimes been called “hodad” as well!

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_06
text: It wobbles the metallic whiskers that sprout from\nits head to communicate with its comrades!

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_07
text: Its shining gold whiskers are advanced sensors\nthat can detect sounds from miles away!

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_08
text: It’s impulsive, selfish, and fickle—but it’s popular\nwith Trainers who like pouring affection on it.

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_09
text: It’s got formidable physical strength, but it’s also\ngot an adorable round face and silky-smooth\r\ncoat that make it mighty popular in Alola!

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_10
text: See, Grimer were brought over to Alola to solve\nthe garbage disposal problems there. Over time,\r\nthe Grimer ended up in this form!

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_11
text: This is a dangerous one! Those things that look\nlike fangs and claws are actually crystallized\r\npoison—touch one, and it’ll afflict you at once!

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_12
text: They say that as Exeggutor grew taller and taller,\nit outgrew its reliance on psychic abilities, and\r\nthe power of the sleeping dragon within it awoke!

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_13
text: It exhales air colder than −58 degrees\nFahrenheit! It’s also sometimes known by\r\nan older name: Keokeo.

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_14
text: It lives deep in the snowy mountains and creates\ndrops of ice in its coat. It even used to be\r\nworshiped as a deity incarnate!

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_15
text: It lives deep in mountainous areas that are\nburied in snow. It’s got a soft belly, but the ice\r\non its back is as hard as steel!

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_16
text: It has developed thick, sharp claws that allow it\nto dash at high speeds even across snowy plains!

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_17
text: Its body is actually a magnetic stone! Iron sand\ngets stuck to the bits that have especially\r\nstrong magnetism.

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_18
text: The stones it likes to eat have caused its whole\nbody to become electrified. It’s got a real\r\ntemper too!

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_19
text: It’s grumpy and stubborn. Upset it, and it’ll let\nout an electric charge and thunder-like growl!

text:

label: sdc02_0080_select_01
text: I was really motivated!

label: sdc02_0080_select_02
text: It was a walk in the park!

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_02
text: So battling isn’t your only talent, then—you’ve\ngot a knack for catching Pokémon too![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_03
text: It’s easy to see how high level the students must\nbe at Naranja Academy![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_04
text: It’s easy to see how high level the students must\nbe at Uva Academy![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_20
text: All right, everyone! Gather round!

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_21
text: We’re all out of time for today, so that’ll have to\nbe it for this class session.

label: sdc02_0080_teacher_22
text: If you didn’t manage to catch a Pokémon in time,\nthat’ll be your homework to complete before our\r\nnext session. Class dismissed!

label: sdc02_0080_mob_01
text: Maaan, really? Guess I’m stuck with homework.

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_05
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So, [VAR 0x0100(0000)],
what
did
you
think
of
your
first
Blueberry
class?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_select_03
text: It was fun!

label: sdc02_0080_select_04
text: It was easy!

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_06
text: Really?! It makes me so happy to hear that![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_07
text: My word, so the classes at your academy are\neven more demanding?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_08
text: Oh! I was supposed to go make an appearance\nat the clubroom! Shoot![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_09
text: I’m afraid this will have to be the end of our little\ntour, but let me leave you with one more tip![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_10
text: Here at Blueberry, we have lots of extracurricular\ntasks you can do called [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Blueberry Quests[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], or just\r\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]BBQs[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] for short![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_15
text: They’re sort of like missions that the school\nassigns to students out and about in the Terarium.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_16
text: You might be asked to have your Pokémon do\nsome Auto Battles or to catch specific Pokémon.\r\nThose sorts of things![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_17
text: You never know what the next BBQ might be or\nwhere you’ll need to go to carry it out.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_18
text: But if you can do what’s asked of you, you’ll earn\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Blueberry Points[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], also called [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]BP[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_11
text:
BP is a kind of school currency you can use in the
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]cafeteria[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] or at the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]school store[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].\c
You might be able to use it for [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]club activities [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]in
the future too...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_12
text: Anyway! The long and the short of it is that you\nshould do BBQs and get yourself BP![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_13
text: And that’s it from me![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_14
text: Sorry for having to dash, but I really must be off\nnow—enjoy your time at Blueberry Academy![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
